ideas.pitch: An AR-powered campus navigation and event onboarding app built for swift device orientation during sudden university venue shifts.
ideas.title: CampusAR Onboarding Flow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the rapid, highly polished mobile workflow of BaseScanner, which won by focusing on a tangible AR utility that judges could immediately test on their phones.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision runner form analyzer that evaluates student track-and-field posture using lightweight pose estimation for real-time feedback.
ideas.title: BiomechSprint
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages direct, hard engineering in computer vision similar to CricketVision_AI, catching the judges' eyes with an engaging, visual demo.

ideas.pitch: An instant dining hall meal scanner and nutrition tracker tuned specifically to local campus menus and student dietary restrictions.
ideas.title: MessNutri AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact blueprint of E-Foodiee-AI-Nutrition-Assistant by delivering an immediately relatable consumer utility built and polished within a tight sprint.

ideas.pitch: Satellite and drone imagery change-detection dashboard designed to monitor unauthorized campus construction or land usage infringements.
ideas.title: EcoCompliant Campus
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the geospatial and operational monitoring angle of GeoNex-ATLAS, appealing to judges looking for impactful enterprise or administrative applications.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered engagement and verification pipeline designed to build trust and coordinate mentorship grants between university alumni and student founders.
ideas.title: AlumniTrust Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the streamlined business workflow and trust-building UI elements seen in Global-Smile, which won a fast-paced 12-hour sprint.
